data.gender_notes: Aflak is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aflak refers to the celestial spheres or orbits in Arabic. It symbolizes a connection to the divine and the universe. The name Aflak carries the meaning “Orbits of the heavens” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aflak usually hope their child will grow to embody orbits of the heavens and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.name: Aflak
in_english.meaning: High heavens or outer space of stars and planets
in_english.long_meaning: Aflak is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning high heavens or the outer space of stars and planets. It symbolizes elevation and sublimity in Islamic tradition. The name Aflak is derived from the Arabic root 'af-laka,' which conveys the sense of vastness and expansiveness. In the Quran, the term 'aflak' refers to the celestial realms, emphasizing the grandeur and majesty of God's creation. Throughout Islamic history, the name Aflak has been used to signify spiritual aspirations and a connection to the divine. In contemporary times, Aflak remains a popular name among Muslim communities worldwide, reflecting a sense of wonder and awe at the mysteries of the universe.
